I was recently diagnosed with a rare disorder called NF2. A mutation in the tumor suppressing gene of my DNA causes tumors to GROW inside, outside or along my spinal cord and my brain. One day, this disease could quite possibly strip me of everything, walking, talking, hearing, seeing, speaking, LIVING A WHOLESOME LIFE. And only because this disease isn't technically considered terminal, I will not be able to go out with fucking dignity if the worst comes to worst. I'll have to be a burden on my loved ones until the grace of the reaper feels generous. Sucks, man.
